styles.name: draw-on
styles.description: Border draws clockwise from top-left; perimeter = progress

styles.name: marching-ants
styles.description: Dashes scroll clockwise around the frame; speed increases with progress

styles.name: corner-brackets
styles.description: Corner brackets extend toward midpoints of each edge as progress fills

styles.name: runner
styles.description: Bright comet races around the full frame perimeter with a fading tail

styles.name: double-frame
styles.description: Outer frame always present; inner frame expands from centre with eased

styles.name: neon-pulse
styles.description: Frame border pulses in dot-density (glow simulation); brighter with progress

styles.name: dashed
styles.description: Dashed frame border; lit dashes accumulate clockwise with eased

styles.name: dotted
styles.description: Sparse dotted frame (1:2 on/off); lit dots accumulate with eased

styles.name: rounded
styles.description: Chamfered/rounded corners via arc dots; straight edges fill with eased

styles.name: fill-frame
styles.description: Frame thickens inward with eased — a border-shaped progress meter

styles.name: ticked-frame
styles.description: Ruler ticks along the top edge with a traveling marker; plain frame elsewhere

styles.name: two-runners
styles.description: Two comet segments race opposite ways; they meet at progress * half-perimeter
